# Preparation of R and data

## Load data and NEPSroutines

```{r load, message = FALSE}

load("dat1.rda")
resp <- dat1$resp
vars <- dat1$vars

library("NEPSroutines")

```

## User-defined missing values

```{r user-defined missing values}

table(unlist(resp[resp < 0]))

mvs = c(
  OM = -97,
  NV = -95,
  NR = -94,
  NP = -56
)

labels_mvs = c(
  ALL = "total missing items",
  OM = "omitted items",
  NV = "not valid items",
  NR = "not reached items",
  NP = "not participated"
)

```

## Attributes for socio-demographic variables

```{r attributes}

# Sex
attributes(resp$sex)$labels <- c(
  female = 0,
  male = 1
)

# Migration
attributes(resp$mig)$labels <- c(
  no_migration_background = 0,
  migration_background = 1
)

# Books
attributes(resp$books)$labels <- c(
  less_than_100 = 0,
  more_than_100 = 1
)

```


# Sample and Booklet Descriptives

```{r descriptives}

# Sample size with only valid cases
NEPSroutines::n_valid(resp, valid = "valid")

# Descriptives (mean, sd, etc.) of continuous variables
NEPSroutines::desc_con(resp, desc = "age", valid = "valid")

# Descriptives (attributes, frequency) of nominal socio-demographic variables
NEPSroutines::show_attributes(resp, desc = c("sex", "mig", "books"))
NEPSroutines::desc_nom(resp, desc = c("sex", "mig", "books"), valid = "valid")


```


# Missing Responses Analyses

## Missing Responses by Person

```{r missing responses by person}

NEPSroutines::mv_person(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "dich",
  valid = "valid",
  mvs = mvs,
  labels_mvs = labels_mvs,
  missing_by_design = -56,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  plots = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables",
  path_plots = "plots/missings_by_person",
  digits = 2,
  warn = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```

## Missing Responses by Item

```{r missing responses by item}

NEPSroutines::mv_item(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "dich",
  valid = "valid",
  position = "pos",
  mvs = mvs,
  labels_mvs = labels_mvs,
  missing_by_design = -56,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  plots = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables",
  path_plots = "plots/missings_by_item",
  digits = 2,
  warn = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```


# IRT Analyses

```{r IRT analysis with dichotomous items}

NEPSroutines::irt_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "dich",
  valid = "valid",
  scoring = "scoring",
  mvs = mvs,
  plots = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables",
  path_plots = "plots",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  digits = 2,
  verbose = FALSE
)

```


# DIF Analysis

```{r dif analysis for Rasch}

NEPSroutines::dif_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  select = "dich",
  valid = "valid",
  mvs = mvs,
  dif_vars = c("sex", "mig"),
  scoring = "scoring",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  save = TRUE,
  print = TRUE,
  return = FALSE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables"
)

```


# Distractor Analysis

```{r distractor analysis}

NEPSroutines::dis_analysis(
  resp = resp,
  vars = vars,
  valid = "valid",
  mvs = mvs,
  select_raw = "raw",
  correct = "correct",
  print = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  path_results = "results",
  path_table = "tables"
)

```


# Dimensionality Analysis

No dimensionality analysis not necessary since no testlet variable exists.


# Create Scores and SUF

```{r suf}

scores <- NEPSroutines::create_scores(
  resp,
  vars,
  score_name = "grk1",
  select = "dich",
  valid = "valid",
  mvs = mvs,
  wle = TRUE,
  sum_score = TRUE,
  sum_select = "dich",
  metap = FALSE,
  return = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  path_results = "results"
)

NEPSroutines::create_suf(
  resp,
  vars,
  select = "dich",
  competence = "Grammar",
  scores = scores,
  score_name = "grk1",
  return = FALSE,
  path = "suf"
)

rm(scores)

```
